start.text: Day five. The insider is handled, and the office is quiet again. Quiet is when the next thing starts.
start.name: Joshua

B.text: IT desk, this is Joshua. How can I help?
B.name: Joshua

C.text: Joshua? It's Priya Anand, from Customer Support. A customer got spam on the address he gave only to us. Nobody else has that address.
C.name: Priya

E1.text: Please check. A customer who trusted us now has spam, and he wants to know who sold his address.
E1.name: Priya

D2.text: I do not know. All of them, I fear. He is only the one who wrote to us.
D2.name: Priya

F.text: We do not know yet. If the list left the building, something sent it. Every transfer leaves a record, and so does every job that runs on a timer.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: [b][color=green]5 clues[/color][/b] should be enough to tell what left, how, and where. Then I fill in the report.
G.name: Joshua
